title: Hunchback Meng and the Beast King
summary: Wang Lin's new demon kills a hurricane beast at the False Nascent Soul level, and the deeper he goes the stronger the beasts inside the hurricanes become. Hunchback Meng's killing draws out the Hurricane Beast King, which is at Soul Formation great perfection. To fight it, Meng takes the inner core of Li Tian, the toad he has raised for a thousand years, and reaches Soul Formation great perfection himself. He kills the Beast King with Nine Nether Poison and the leftover poison of his Poison King Cauldron, but loses his life-bound treasure and is left drained. Seeing that Meng is almost spent, Wang Lin decides he cannot kill him with strength alone but can still finish him, and he attacks. Meng sees him, and as the fight stirs up the hurricanes, Wang Lin finds there is no going back.
